learning_outcomes.text: The student will be able to express a given physical problem (and/or calculation process) mathematically and solve it by writing a computer program.
The student will be able to write program code using the program algorithm and flowchart.
The student will be able to understand a written program, interpret it and make necessary changes.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to computer. Working principles of computers. Algorithm preparation
Drawing flowcharts. Converting algorithm to flowchart.
Introduction to Fortran 90 that is especially suited to numeric computation and scientific computing. Historical development. Compilers.
Basic math operations, integers, real numbers, complex numbers. Character processing.
Logical operators, comparison expressions. (IF, CASE, WHERE)
Some important commands and examples of nested loops and their applications.
Applications and solutions of various engineering problems with Fortran 90.
Applications and solutions of various engineering problems with Fortran 90.
